rules.clause: Meals are reimbursed up to USD 80.00 per expense.
Client entertainment is reimbursed up to USD 150.00 per expense.
Meals and entertainment are reimbursable Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 22:00.
Ground transport (taxis, rideshare, trains) is limited to USD 200.00 per employee per calendar month.
Any single expense above USD 80.00 requires a pre-approval ID from your manager.
Alcohol is not reimbursable.

uncompilable.clause: Client meals require a reasonable business justification.

uncompilable.clause: We prefer partner hotels whenever one is available.

uncompilable.clause: Flights are reimbursed up to USD 900.00 per ticket.

uncompilable.clause: Book economy class unless the flight is longer than 8 hours.
uncompilable.reason: Requires fare class and flight duration, which the rule types cannot evaluate.

uncompilable.clause: Personal expenses are not reimbursable.
uncompilable.reason: Whether an expense is personal requires human judgement and does not map to a single category.
